title: Fundsmith Equity Fund Update Webinar - July 2026
description: Terry Smith shares the latest on Fundsmith Equity Fund — covering performance, portfolio activity and the modifications to the ‘Do Nothing’ leg of the investment process as set out in the Semi-Annual Letter to Shareholders.
summary: The Fundsmith Equity Fund Update argues that the portfolio is anchored by high-conviction positions in cybersecurity and analog semiconductors, specifically Fortinet and Texas Instruments, which have delivered strong returns following post-pandemic corrections. Conversely, the speaker expresses significant caution regarding luxury goods dependent on China's property market recovery and avoids speculative growth stocks or companies where fundamental issues could trigger volatility. The broader strategy involves maintaining neutral exposure to major tech giants and AI infrastructure plays to avoid negating index returns while waiting for clearer fundamental inflection points.
